meta.note: A seeded, invented history of earlier weekly decisions, so the board's 'delay cost avoided' tile and the finance view have something to show, as slide 9 does. Nothing here was measured or comes from Chin Hin. The ringgit is computed by the calculator from each project's and customer's card; the days and volumes below are the only inputs.

provenance.entries: ILLUSTRATIVE: five decisions in the five weeks before the story. The days avoided on the three where a project went first (2 + 2 + 3) were chosen so the calculator's total rounds to the RM246k the deck's slide 9 shows; the two where an outside order went first show the rule serving the outside side when the project has float. Approvers, volumes and customers are invented.
